title: Outlook keeps prompting for password after password change
description: User changed her password yesterday. Outlook desktop now prompts for credentials every few minutes. OWA works fine. Only affects her workstation (ACME-FD01).
resolution: Cleared cached Office credentials in Credential Manager, signed out of all Office apps, removed and re-added the account in Outlook. Prompts stopped. Confirmed MFA method was still registered.

title: Outlook stuck on 'Updating' and not receiving new mail
description: Dispatch lead says Outlook has shown 'Updating Inbox' all morning. New mail visible on phone but not desktop.
resolution: OST was 48 GB and corrupted. Rebuilt the Outlook profile and set cached mode to 6 months. Mail synced within 20 minutes.

title: Outlook repeatedly asking for password on two workstations
description: Two paralegals report Outlook prompting for their password over and over since Monday. Both changed passwords last week per the firm's 90 day policy. Web mail works.

title: Suspicious inbox rule forwarding mail to external address
description: Loan officer noticed replies to emails she never sent. Found an inbox rule named '..' forwarding all mail containing 'invoice' or 'wire' to an external Gmail address.
resolution: Disabled the rule, revoked all sessions, reset password, enforced MFA re-registration. Sign-in logs showed a successful login from an overseas IP 3 days prior. Blocked automatic external forwarding in the outbound spam policy for the tenant. Notified client contact and documented timeline for their compliance team.

title: User reported phishing email, may have clicked link
description: Estimator forwarded a 'DocuSign' email asking him to review a bid package. He says he clicked the link but is not sure if he entered his password. Needs sign-in review and possible password reset.

title: Front desk printer showing offline
description: HP LaserJet at front desk shows offline on both check-in PCs. Printer display shows it is on the network. Staff are walking to the back office printer in the meantime.

title: Datto backup failing on BW-FS01 for three nights
description: Backup alert for BW-FS01 (file server). Last successful backup was 4 days ago. Error references a failed snapshot. No changes reported by client.

title: Datto backup failed screenshot verification on BW-DC01
description: Screenshot verification failing on the domain controller for two days. Backups themselves completing.
resolution: VSS writers were in a failed state. Restarted the affected services, rebooted during the maintenance window, forced a new backup. Screenshot verification passed on the next run.

title: New hire onboarding: two tellers starting Monday
description: Two new tellers start Monday. Need M365 accounts, licenses, security group membership for the branch, core banking access request submitted to their vendor, and two workstations imaged.

title: Conference room access point offline
description: Wi-Fi in the main conference room is weak or unavailable. Controller shows the AP in the conference room as disconnected. Client has a deposition scheduled there next week.

title: Jobsite trailer VPN will not connect
description: Site VPN from the jobsite trailer to the main office dropped overnight and will not come back up.
resolution: ISP changed the trailer's public IP. Updated the remote peer address on the main office firewall and re-established the tunnel. Asked client to request a static IP from the ISP.

title: Field laptop cannot connect to VPN from jobsite hotspot
description: PM's laptop connects to the internet over a cellular hotspot but the VPN client times out. Works fine from home Wi-Fi.

title: Request: Visio license for office manager
description: Office manager wants Visio to redo the office floor plan for the new operatory. Needs quote approval before purchase.

title: Shared mailbox intake@ not showing for new paralegal
description: New paralegal cannot see the intake shared mailbox in Outlook.
resolution: User had Send As but not Full Access. Granted Full Access with automapping enabled. Mailbox appeared after Outlook restart about an hour later.

title: DMARC reports showing failures from marketing platform
description: DMARC aggregate reports show a high volume of failing mail from the credit union's newsletter platform. Policy is currently p=none. Client wants to move to quarantine.

title: Dispatch laptop very slow after Windows update
description: Laptop takes 10 minutes to boot and the routing software freezes since last night's updates. Disk shows 100% usage in Task Manager.

title: Teams calls drop audio after a few minutes
description: Front desk headset loses audio partway through Teams calls. Caller can still hear them.
resolution: Disabled USB selective suspend and power saving on the USB hub in Device Manager, updated the headset firmware and the Teams client. No drops reported after a week.

title: No audio in Teams on new laptop
description: Attorney received a new laptop this week. Teams calls connect but there is no audio in or out with his USB headset. Laptop speakers work.

title: Offboarding: project manager last day Friday
description: PM Tom Avery's last day is Friday. Disable account end of day, convert mailbox to shared with access for Maria Chen, transfer OneDrive files, collect laptop and remove from management.

title: EDR alert: encoded PowerShell command on NP-TELLER03
description: EDR flagged an encoded PowerShell command launched from a Word process on NP-TELLER03. Device isolated automatically. Need investigation and user follow up.

title: User account locking out repeatedly
description: Teller locked out four times this morning. Each unlock lasts about 15 minutes.
resolution: Lockout source traced to an old phone still signed into the mail app with the previous password. User removed the account from the old phone. No further lockouts.

title: SSL certificate for patient portal expires in 10 days
description: Monitoring flagged the patient portal certificate expiring soon. Portal is hosted by a third party vendor; need to confirm who renews it.

title: License review: list unassigned and unused licenses
description: Account manager wants a list of unassigned licenses and users who have not signed in for 30+ days before the quarterly business review.

title: Plotter not printing large format drawings
description: Wide format plotter accepts jobs but nothing prints. Small test pages work.
resolution: Print spooler was stuck on a corrupted job. Cleared the spooler queue and reinstalled the vendor driver with the HPGL/2 option. Large format jobs printing normally.
